recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants the unused Patient Contact Relationship value set explicitly deprecated or generated Patient diagrams regenerated, handle that under FHIR-15841 or a follow-up tracker rather than changing FHIR-17472.
issue_request: FHIR-17472 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a new Patient contact relationship value set that excludes the v2-0131 Other code because including Other made an extensible binding problematic.
initial_application: Commit e9ce6c1043c051523fcbbc529aae0a0cf5c5a3e8 applied the issue by changing the old Patient ContactRelationship binding from the full v2-0131 value set to valueset-patient-contactrelationship and adding source/patient/valueset-patient-contactrelationship.xml. The current value set still filters v2-0131 with concept is-not-a O.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied/Persuasive-with-Modification issue FHIR-15841 split Patient.contact.relationship from a new Patient.contact.role, changed Patient.contact.relationship to a preferred binding on v3-PersonalRelationshipRoleType, and added Patient.contact.role with a preferred binding on relatedperson-relationshiptype. That later model supersedes the old extensible PatientContactRelationship binding target for current Patient contact content.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Rebinding the current Patient.contact.role to patient-contactrelationship, or excluding v2-0131 O from the current preferred role value set for this seed, would conflict with the later FHIR-15841 model rather than complete FHIR-17472.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Patient Administration decision split personal relationship from functional role and changed the current Patient contact binding targets and strengths.
